evidenceLimits: Complete relevant families, not the complete dictionary. Omission does not prove absence. Selected senses are non-exhaustive and not independent level assignments. Mapping/source notes are author assertions to assess, not reviewer findings.

rows.mappingNote: New transitive smashing/crushing article; physical fragmentation remains the source-selected use.
rows.sourceNote: Additional hopes and accessible-explanation uses are distinguished. Rare 摧く is recognized, not promoted as usual spelling. Daijisen's numbered definitions are not JMdict indices.

rows.mappingNote: New intransitive break-into-pieces article, with an additional relaxed/informal use.
rows.sourceNote: Physical fragments and reduced formality are taught separately. All other complete-family senses remain evidence for possible quiz ambiguity, not silently assigned N2.

rows.mappingNote: New usual-kana ichidan article teaches fatigue and objects worn by use.
rows.sourceNote: The auxiliary after a masu stem is explicitly additional. Grass/prostration character glosses do not derive the ateji reading 草臥れる; 疲れる is not restricted to people.

rows.mappingNote: New usual-kana i-adjective article covers worthless/trivial and foolish/nonsensical evaluations.
rows.sourceNote: Do not flatten it into merely boring or neutral smallness. Downward-motion spelling association is not a historical origin claim or a replacement for lexical teaching.

rows.mappingNote: New godan intransitive descent/downstream article, with path-marking を.
rows.sourceNote: Existing 降る has primary reading ふる, not source coverage for くだる. Orders/judgments handed down are additional; other complete-family senses remain separately inspectable.

rows.mappingNote: New lip/lips noun article distinguishing lips from the whole mouth.
rows.sourceNote: Retain written 唇 despite the missing kanji card. Rare 脣 is recognized, and upper/lower lip terms are supported by complete comparison families.

rows.mappingNote: New native-reading lipstick article with substantive 口 and 紅 links.
rows.sourceNote: 紅's cosmetic sense is reading-restricted to べに. Add a reciprocal N2 example on 紅; the compound does not mean every makeup or lip-care product.

source.waller_definition: to adhere to,to keep close to

rows.mappingNote: New usual-kana godan intransitive article positively teaches adherence and staying close.
rows.sourceNote: Recognize くっ付く without manufacturing a separate pronunciation or physical-only rule. Intimacy is additional, and homophonic 着く is not an attachment synonym.

rows.mappingNote: New usual-kana transitive ichidan article for attaching, with additional side-by-side and colloquial matchmaking uses.
rows.sourceNote: Contact need not involve glue. Keep object を and destination に distinct from the intransitive counterpart; matchmaking is not every marriage use.

rows.mappingNote: New usual-kana i-adjective article teaches repetitive/insistent expression and excessive taste; additional gaudy-color use.
rows.sourceNote: Daijisen has two definitions, combining taste and color in the second; do not invent a third Daijisen definition from JMdict numbering. Persistence/taste overlap with しつこい is retained.

rows.mappingNote: New punctuation-mark article teaches central 。/、 and the くとうてん reading.
rows.sourceNote: 読 uses トウ, not ドク. Partial public evidence came from 新語時事用語辞典, not Daijisen; complete JMdict 句点/読点/句読 families support component-word explanation.

rows.mappingNote: New godan transitive distribute/hand-out/deliver article; allocating/stationing people is additional.
rows.sourceNote: No exceptionless recipient-count boundary is imposed against 届ける or 渡す. Rare 賦る is lookup evidence; 気を配る is a qualified expression, not bare worry.

rows.mappingNote: New くふう article for devising a useful approach and its resulting practical idea; mapping follows the concordant source kana and supplied entry ID.
rows.sourceNote: This is an explicit source-gloss correction, not literal coverage of worker at くふう. Complete 1278230 flags the worker word dated and sensitive; it does not independently gain N2. Daijisen separately defines both readings.
rows.identityNote: Raw source gloss labourer,worker belongs to the distinct 工夫 こうふ family 1278230, not supplied 1278220 くふう. Preserve the original row unchanged; resolve its contradictory gloss through the reading-specific dictionary entries.

rows.mappingNote: New division/section and classification article, noun and transitive suru.
rows.sourceNote: Add reciprocal N2 区 link. Do not reduce classification to geographic districts or import logic-specialist sense 3 as required teaching.

rows.mappingNote: New native combination noun article at 組み合わせ, explicitly covering source alias 組合せ and the other unrestricted spellings.
rows.sourceNote: Contest pairings and mathematical combinations are additional. Noun is distinguished from the verb 組み合わせる; okurigana variation does not impose semantic compartments.
rows.identityNote: 組み合わせ, 組合せ, 組合わせ and 組み合せ share unrestricted reading くみあわせ and senses in complete 1592290.

rows.mappingNote: New transitive ichidan assemble/construct article, including physical parts and a story's structure.
rows.sourceNote: Grammar sentence formation is additional. Recognize 組立てる; search-only 組み立る is retained in evidence, not recommended as ordinary writing.

rows.mappingNote: New water-drawing/scooping godan article with additional pouring/drinking and considering-feelings overlap.
rows.sourceNote: Retain missing 汲 in metadata. Do not reuse 組む or assign every sense of Daijisen's combined 汲む/酌む heading freely to both spellings; complete individual families establish the real overlap.

rows.mappingNote: New sake-serving/sharing godan article with additional considering-feelings use.
rows.sourceNote: Retain missing 酌 in metadata. Public spelling note supports sake-serving 酌む without a water-only/sake-only or literal-only/figurative-only partition from 汲む.

rows.mappingNote: New i-adjective article for bitter frustration, mortification and disappointment over failure or unfairness.
rows.sourceNote: Raw regrettable is contextualized as a bitter feeling, not only bland regret. Flavor-bitter 苦い and search-only 悔やしい are not ordinary equivalents.

rows.mappingNote: New godan article positively teaches source-selected mourning, with additional regret about a past act/result.
rows.sourceNote: JMdict sense 1 is mourn and sense 2 regret; Daijisen reverses their order. A death being lamented does not imply the speaker caused it, and the verb is not a general spoken apology.

reviewEvidence.provenance: 262 complete comparison families extracted for 233 forms after verifying both pinned JMdict gzip and XML SHA256 values. Every principal and comparison family was inspected, including restrictions, flags, inherited POS and ordinary secondary senses. The compact comparison derivative was read through all 1885 physical lines; only empty fields were omitted and identical repeated POS explicitly abbreviated as ditto. Thirty complete Japanese-reading/English-meaning KANJIDIC2 component records and 146 existing comparison-card labels/exclusions were also inspected. Public inspection receipts describe actual author access, not independent reviewer retrieval. A seven-form supplement was subsequently extracted with both source hashes checked and its complete nonempty-field reading derivative inspected through EOF: 上唇, 下唇, 気を配る, 噛み砕く, 砕けた, 待ちくたびれる, 組み合わせる. The final common packet contains 269 complete comparison families. 上唇's zoological labrum sense is restricted to じょうしん and not transferred to うわくちびる.

actualEntryInspections.headword: くふう【工夫】 and separate こうふ【工夫】
actualEntryInspections.location: Actual raw-HTML bodies approximately characters 48000-63000; the earlier simplified extraction was footer material, not verification.
actualEntryInspections.observation: くふう concerns thinking out good methods/means and the resulting method, with a separate Buddhist use. こうふ denotes a civil-engineering/construction laborer.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Preserve raw labourer,worker but do not teach it at くふう. The concordant source reading and supplied entry ID select 1278220; complete 1278230 separately supplies dated/sensitive flags. Neither homograph identity nor N2 classification transfers.

actualEntryInspections.observation: Definition 1 regrets past failure; definition 2 laments a death, including a close-friend death collocation.
actualEntryInspections.limits: JMdict numbering is the reverse: selected sense 1 mourn; additional sense 2 regret. The mourning use must be positively taught, not replaced with regret alone.

actualEntryInspections.location: Actual combined-entry raw-HTML body approximately characters 49000-58500.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Drawing liquid, pouring/drinking, inferring feelings, appreciation and inheriting tradition occur in the combined entry. The supplement specifies 酌む for sake-serving.
actualEntryInspections.limits: A combined heading does not assign all senses to all spellings. Complete individual JMdict families establish pouring/drinking and feelings overlap; no absolute water/sake or literal/figurative partition is inferred.

actualEntryInspections.source: 新語時事用語辞典 on Weblio, partial body

actualEntryInspections.observation: Central Japanese 。/、 punctuation and broader punctuation including question/exclamation marks.
actualEntryInspections.limits: This was not Daijisen and was not a complete entry inspection. Complete pinned JMdict 句読点/句点/読点/句読 families support the teaching; no broad typographic style rule is inferred.

actualEntryInspections.location: Raw characters 49000-58000 contained the separate クドい article, Daijisen heading and first definition. A follow-up 58000-62500 read the end of definition 2 and entry close.

quizGuardRationale: Exclusions are direct, symmetric and nontransitive. Existing 146 labels were inspected along with complete families, rather than treating different titles as proof of uniqueness. No baseline exclusion changes are made.

砕く/砕ける protect ordinary break/crush/collapse labels and broader simple/accessible labels. 砕く also protects plain explanation/division and qualified worry/effort through the inspected Daijisen expressions; these are not new N2 assignments. 砕ける's complete decline, affability and worry senses matter even though the lesson selects physical breaking and adds informal speech.

くたびれる protects exhaustion, wear and the complete auxiliary tired-of use. 疲れる and vivid fatigue expressions are not partitioned into people-only or objects-only. がっかり's complete weariness use is retained in evidence, rather than considering only its primary disappointment title.
くだらない protects worthless, futile, foolish and the broad boring/tedious answer area shared with つまらない. The text does not turn the words into exceptionlessly interchangeable adjectives.

下る protects descent and ordinary secondary time-passing/inferiority labels. No ふる weather guard is inferred just from the alternate spelling 降る; a modern downward-travel lesson does not transfer classical precipitation to everyday teaching.

唇 is not equated with the whole mouth by anatomy alone. 口紅 protects general makeup wording conservatively but does not teach every cosmetic or lip-care product as lipstick. 紅's cosmetic sense stays restricted to べに.

くっつく/くっつける protect attachment and place-together labels, including ordinary proximity/intimacy or colloquial matchmaking where applicable. Physical contact, grammatical transitivity and becoming married are distinguished in prose. Homophonic arriving 着く is not a synonym.

くどい protects insistent/annoying/repetitive, rich/heavy/strong taste and tedious labels. Mere length alone does not establish tiring excess, and persistence is not restricted to people in the しつこい comparison.
句読点 protects broad mark/symbol/point labels without equating every symbol with punctuation. 句点/読点 and 読's トウ are positively taught.

配る protects delivery, handing over, giving/dividing and allocation/stationing labels, including broad provision in 給与. Recipient count is not used as an absolute boundary. 気を配る remains a whole expression, not bare worry.
工夫 protects devising/idea/design/plan/invention and practical method/device labels. This does not equate every idea with a machine or transfer the separate laborer homograph into くふう.
区分 protects division, section, classification, grouping and spatial/organizational subdivision labels. A division need not be a municipal district; fixed size and official status are not inferred.

組み合わせ protects combination/set, arrangement and contest matching labels; 組み立てる protects assembly, construction and composition, including story/sentence construction. A contest pairing is not itself every contest; ordinary make/build labels are checked directly.

汲む/酌む protect actual pouring/drinking and feelings-understanding/consideration overlap; 汲む additionally protects complete-family inheritance. Drawing a picture is not drawing water, and unrelated 組む is not merged by sound.

悔しい protects bitter disappointment/frustration and applicable annoyed/regrettable labels; 苦い's explicit flavor title remains distinct. 悔やむ protects mourning and regret/lamentation, including the complete usually-kana regret family at 恨む, without transferring every resentment use or making the verb a spoken apology.
sourceAccessLimits: Twenty new articles cover twenty source rows; no existing word is claimed as newly reviewed reuse. 組合せ maps explicitly to 組み合わせ with all four unrestricted spellings retained.
The contradictory 工夫 gloss is preserved raw and explicitly corrected through the agreeing reading and entry ID. Worker at こうふ is not claimed as N2 coverage or taught as くふう.
Two new primary-form reciprocal N2 pairs: 紅/口紅 and 区/区分. Existing 読 receives only a link around its already-present 句読点 example.
Missing primary component cards 砕, 唇, 句, 汲, 酌 and 悔 are not manufactured; all written characters remain in metadata. Missing comparison articles remain plain text.
All baseline identities, primary readings, titles, written-kanji arrays, easier levels and established exclusions are preserved; only the already recorded batch-19 機械/道具 exception exists.
Complete families include unrelated homographs, search-only forms and unselected specialist/historical senses. Their presence is not permission to transfer meanings or restrictions.
The community N2 list is not an official syllabus. Additional senses and quiz-only comparison senses do not independently gain N2 classification.
Public receipts record actual qualified author access. Original examples are not corpus quotations, frequency measurements, native-speaker certification or executed app draws.
Component associations aid learning but are not invented historical etymologies. Initial and corrected-snapshot review evidence derivatives omit only the author's quiz rationale.
